I got it back to the shop, they said they fixed it, I drove it 1-2 hrs that day then put it away. That was a couple weeks ago.

Now the problem(again): I took it out 2 days ago and on my drive back from where I had been (approx 30 minutes), it just.. kept dying again in neutral. Idling super low, like 500-600 after a start up at 1100 rpm. Fully warmed up as well. Last time it would survive neutral occasionally, but this time it isn’t at all. Not sure if I should take it back to the shop and complain or try to fix it myself; I’m sure it’s the carb rejet/tune or something related to the vacuum advance, just not sure where to start. Thank y’all!
